artboards.title: Table view — unchanged, with the switch

annotations.text:
SEASON chip (above the board)

early = the real FY2028 data today: 17 of 19 offices not started, OPA in progress, PPDO returned.

mid = SAMPLE figures, to show a board with work spread across every column. Flip it to compare.

VIEW SWITCH — RESOLVED 2026-09-13

Board / Table sits in the Offices section header. Board is the default for cross-office reviewers and SuperAdmin; the table itself is unchanged.

Decided: remember each person's last choice on this device.

BUDGET OFFICER — RESOLVED 2026-09-13

Table only, no switch. The board adds where each office sits in review, which they do not act on; ceilings, costed and the Over ceiling / Cannot submit pills are already in the table.

Someone holding both grants gets the switch.

NOT STARTED — compact rows

Code, program count, and a red dot when nobody in the office can submit — so 17 offices do not become one tall column of cards.

Open: compact rows like this, or collapse the column to a count until clicked?

MONEY ON CARDS — RESOLVED 2026-09-13

Kept, abbreviated (₱1.12M of ₱10M); the table keeps exact pesos. Over ceiling means little without the two figures beside it.

CLICKING AN OFFICE

A card opens AIP Review search filtered to that office (spec §6.3).

Open: should Not started rows be clickable too? There is nothing to review in them yet.

CARD FIELDS

Strike any that do not earn their place:
• code + Host + Returned
• office name
• programs · activities
• costed of ceiling
• risk pills
• reviewer
